hook.name: TripoolsAntiSnipeHook
hook.description: A shared Uniswap v4 hook for Tripools token-launch pools that enforces a 6-second anti-snipe window (50% flat tax on non-whitelisted buys) and a dynamic tiered fee schedule on all swaps. Ordinary buy/sell taxes split 20% to a protocol treasury and 80% accrued for the token creator in ETH; snipe taxes route 100% to the treasury.
